Nivel de vechime: Asociat
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
Who We Are
 We are looking for a Senior Full-Stack Developer to join our team and contribute to the development of modern, scalable applications, with a strong focus on AI-powered solutions and intelligent software capabilities.
The ideal candidate combines advanced Angular/TypeScript expertise with solid Java/Spring Boot experience and is comfortable working across the full technology stack. You will be involved in designing and delivering end-to-end solutions, integrating AI capabilities into existing and new applications, and contributing to the continuous improvement of our software architecture and engineering practices.
 What You'll Be Doing
Design, develop and maintain scalable full-stack applications using Angular/TypeScript and Java/Spring Boot
Contribute to the integration and implementation of AI-powered features and services within business applications
Design and consume REST APIs and develop robust integrations with internal and external systems
Work with SQL databases, ensuring efficient data access and optimized queries
Apply best practices in secure coding, automated testing and software quality
Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment processes
Identify and resolve complex technical issues, with a strong focus on performance, reliability and scalability
Support applications in production and perform end-to-end troubleshooting across frontend, backend, integrations and infrastructure
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into reliable and innovative technical solutions
Stay up to date with emerging technologies, particularly in AI, software architecture and modern development practice
 What You'll Bring Along
BSc/MSc in Computer Science or related field
8+ years of software engineering experience, including senior-level full-stack development
Advanced knowledge of Angular and TypeScript
Solid experience with Java and Spring Boot
Strong understanding of REST APIs, system integrations and distributed applications
Good knowledge of SQL and relational databases
Experience with automated testing, secure coding and CI/CD
Proven ability to troubleshoot complex issues across the full application stack
Experience with performance optimization and production support
Hands-on experience with AI technologies, AI APIs, LLMs or AI-driven application development 
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently and collaborative
